sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Postman Pat - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Come on in, make yourself at home. How's the life of constant battle? No extra preternatural holes in your hide? Jolly good. No freaking use for them, eh? I’m in a bit of a tight unpleasant spot here. Will you help me out? My messenger vanished. I entrusted a job for this local waste of skin, he played so tough. In short, I’ve sent a little note to Therapist with some proposals for a mutually beneficial cooperation. Nothing special, but nothing outsiders should know either. And so this meat sack went missing, and a little bird told me that this postman got whacked somewhere in the Factory. Why the heck would he go there, that moron? Told him to take the straight path. So anyway, find the body and check it, my scribbles might still be there. And if by some miracle they are, hand them to that medic woman, will ya?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the dead messenger and obtain his letter on Factory
- Survive and extract from the location
- Hand over the letter to Therapist

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Prapor Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Now that’s what it means to work with proven man! Said, done!"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Sealed letter | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
The dead messenger is located in a bunker on the main floor of Factory. For orientation, the number "1986" can be seen painted above the bunker on the wall. The letter can be found next to his body on the ground.

The letter must be handed over to Therapist for her quest Postman Pat - Part 2 before this quest can be completed.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The quest name is a reference to the British children's TV show "Postman Pat."
